subject: reasoning
question: Sia starts from Point A and drives 10.7 km towards the north. She then takes a right turn, drives 8.2 km, turns right and drives 14.3 km. She then takes a right turn and drives 5.4 km. Further she takes a right turn, drives 3.2 km and takes a final left turn, drives 2.8km and stops at Point P. How far and towards which direction should she now drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: Sia starts from Point A and drives 10.7 km towards the north. She then takes a right turn, drives 8.2 km, turns right and drives 14.3 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e43855b9288f608ce85abc334041ce523aef7a2290fc4bf39a3bfa91532622e3.png] 

Step 2: She then takes a right turn and drives 5.4 km. Further she takes a right turn, drives 3.2 km

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/579a426d3e58c0a3866609658ebc1c8a0d4d5bc246e9e923c806ef227bb3a52f.png] 

Step 3: And takes a final left turn, drives 2.8km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244d1108c3a45db9fe83b4cc99579302fbcdbc4e06676d82686ccbc9f37cfd85.png] 

**Distance from point P to A = 14.3 - (10.7 + 3.2) ⇒ 14.3 - 13.9 = 0.4km**

From the diagram, we can see that **Sia have to drive 0.4km towards north to reach Point A.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"option (3)".**
